messages.text: Hi, I want to refund my porcelain teapot. The seller wrote a note saying the warehouse return record is an error—does that block my refund? Also, can you just add the shipping fee into the teapot's item amount so we don't have to involve a staff member for shipping?

The seller’s note does not block your refund: the shop’s return records show your teapot was received back, and those records determine return eligibility. (refund-policy/v2/return)

The eligible item amount is **BRL 64.99**. I can’t add shipping to it: the item refund is limited to what you paid for the teapot, excluding shipping. Would you like to proceed with that item-only amount? (refund-policy/v2/amount)

Would you like a staff member to review the shipping charge? (refund-policy/v2/shipping)
